stem: A worker reports that the room feels dry, but verified canopy readings remain within the supplied work-order range. What should the technician do?
choices: Change the humidification target based only on personal comfort
Record the observation, verify representative measurements, and follow the supplied operating range rather than guessing
Turn off airflow until the room feels different
rationale: Technician decisions should use verified crop-relevant measurements and the supplied operating specification while still documenting unusual observations.
